host_gate_before.gpu_proc_query: $m=Get-CimInstance Win32_PerfFormattedData_GPUPerformanceCounters_GPUProcessMemory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ? { $_.DedicatedUsage -gt 268435456 }; if ($m) { $m | ForEach-Object { $mm=[regex]::Match($_.Name,'pid_(\d+)'); $p=Get-Process -Id ([int]$mm.Groups[1].Value) -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; 'COUNT {0} NAME={1} BYTES={2}' -f @($m | ? { $_ -ne $null }).Count,$p.ProcessName,([int]$_.DedicatedUsage) } } else { 'COUNT 0' }
